subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the two people deep in discussion

706930101.text: That's what I'm saying! We've figured it out.

706930102.text: Eula detests rigid, stuffy people the most! You know, the kind with 'narrow-mindedness' written all over their faces. They always get stuck obsessing over the tiniest details, and all they do is trip people up on every little step!

706930103.text: Maybe they even wear a monocle and can't go anywhere without a book in their hands. But when you take a closer look, you realize they haven't really read it though, and are just using it as a prop...

706930104.text: What they're really trying to do is to put on a so-called intellectual aura, and get a leg up on you before the conversation even starts!

706930105.text: Haha, that was spot on. I can picture it already!

706930106.text: Yanfei and... Amber? Now that's a duo Paimon's never seen before!

706930109.text: Oh hey, Honorary Knight and Paimon! You're here!

706930110.text: Yanfei and I were just discussing if we should have a few "Big Bad Snowman" as Easter eggs in our game.

706930111.text: Ooh, like targets that look like monsters?

706930112.text: We were thinking that, apart from the more typical monsters, we could also include some less traditional characters.

706930113.text: Looks like Yanfei and I share too many similar ideas about the casting!
